product_metadata.title: Hawaiian Shaved Ice S700 Kid-Friendly Snow Cone Machine Kit with 3 - 16oz. Syrup Flavors: Cherry, Grape, and Blue Raspberry, Plus 25 Snow Cone Cups, 25 Spoon Straws, and 3 Black Bottle Pourers
features: Make perfectly crunchable snow right in your own kitchen with the kid-friendly S700 Electric Snow Cone Machine. Make a margarita, slushie, granita, iced coffee, or any other frozen snowball treat you can think of. Your own icy treat station at home. The Hawaiian Shaved Ice countertop snocone maker is simple to use and clean. Portable, easy to store when not in use.

Use homemade ice cubes or keep a bag of ice cubes in your freezer. Set includes all the supplies needed to get the party started - kid-friendly S700 machine, 3 - 16oz. plastic syrup bottles with red Cherry, Grape, and Blue Raspberry flavors, plus accessories: 25 snow cone cups, 25 spoon straws, and 3 black bottle pourers.
Each 16oz. bottle makes approximately 8 six-ounce perfectly-flavored snow cones. With a 2-ounce pour, the entire kit can make 24 six-ounce snow cones. Make it “skinny” by using a little less.

Standard 120-volt electrical plug-in. The S700 electric shaved ice machine easy to operate and stores conveniently away when not in use. Our syrups are best for those with food allergies. Shelf-stable high fructose corn syrup requires no refrigeration and is nut-free. None of the flavors contain soy, wheat, dairy, starch, flour, or egg products. Most syrups have a shelf life of 2 to 3 years. Not from concentrate, no need to add water.

Syrup Flavors: Cherry, Grape, and Blue Raspberry. Check out our store with more great flavor options. Give your blender a break and put a new twist on your evening cocktail, add flavor to your margarita, Coke, and other drinks like granitas, seltzers, Italian soda, icee, black coffee, hot chocolate, slushie, smoothies, shakes, popsicles, cola, and more. Add a dash of flavor to nearly anything with this variety of options at a great value. Not just for a shaved ice or snow cone machine!
